name: Cabal of the Inverted Star
identity: Warp-geomancer sorcerers, hollow automata and mutating spawn. Every Sorcerer casts one spell per activation: cast safely on 2D6 or channel on 3D6 for a stronger effect and a backlash risk. Signature trick: swapping two of your units.

rules.name: The Inverted Rite (spells)
rules.description: Each Sorcerer (a Leader with a [PSYCHIC / ARCANE] weapon) may cast 1 spell per activation without spending an Action; each spell once per round for the army. Roll 2D6 (safe) or 3D6 (channel: the effect is doubled where marked ×2; if 2+ dice show a 1, the Sorcerer suffers D3 Fatal Wounds). Spells: Hex-Bolt (6+) D3 Fatal Wounds to an enemy unit within 18″ ×2 · Veil of Mirrors (6+) a friendly unit within 12″ is −1 to be Hit until the End of Round · Warp-Breach (7+) a friendly unit's weapons get +1 PEN this round · Withering Gaze (7+) an enemy unit within 18″ gets −1 to Hit until the End of Round · Chrono-Step (8+) a friendly unit within 12″ makes a 3″ move ×2 · Inverted Geometry (9+) swap two friendly unengaged units within 18″ of the Sorcerer (counts as their move).

rules.name: Gamble — Channel the Star
rules.description: Built into every cast: roll 3D6 instead of 2D6 — marked effects are doubled; if two or more dice show a 1, the Sorcerer suffers D3 Fatal Wounds. (Risk: durability (dice).)

rules.name: Coven
